pictures.scene: Ivan Kramskoi, Christ in the Wilderness — Christ sitting alone on the stones at daybreak with his hands locked together, a Psalm of David when he was in the Wilderness of Judah, O God You are my God

pictures.scene: Duccio di Buoninsegna, Christ and the Samaritan Woman — the woman at the well with her jar, turned to the one asking her for water, earnestly I seek You, my soul thirsts for You
pictures.name: pd_duccio_christ_and_the_samaritan_woman

pictures.scene: William Holman Hunt, The Scapegoat — the goat left standing on the cracked salt flats of the dead sea shore, my body yearns for You, in a dry and weary land without water
pictures.name: pd_holman_hunt_the_scapegoat

pictures.scene: Giovanni Paolo Panini, Interior of Saint Peter's, Rome — the enormous nave opening up above the small figures walking in it, so I have seen You in the sanctuary, and beheld Your power and glory
pictures.name: pd_panini_interior_of_saint_peters_rome

pictures.scene: Adolph Tidemand, Low Church Devotion — the farm people gathered close in the plain room with their faces lifted as one speaks, because Your loving devotion is better than life, my lips will glorify You
pictures.name: pd_tidemand_low_church_devotion

pictures.scene: John Everett Millais, Victory, O Lord! — Moses held up on the hill with his arms raised and steadied on either side, so I will bless You as long as I live, in Your name I will lift my hands
pictures.name: pd_millais_victory_o_lord

pictures.scene: Jan Steen, As the Old Sing, So Pipe the Young — the old man raising his glass at the loaded table with the whole house singing, my soul is satisfied as with the richest of foods, with joyful lips my mouth will praise You
pictures.name: pd_steen_as_the_old_sing_so_pipe_the_young

pictures.scene: José de Ribera, Jacob's Dream — Jacob asleep on the open ground with the light breaking over him in the night, when I remember You on my bed, I think of You through the watches of the night
pictures.name: pd_ribera_jacobs_dream

pictures.scene: William-Adolphe Bouguereau, Song of the Angels — the three angels standing close with their wings up and their instruments playing, for You are my help, I will sing for joy in the shadow of Your wings
pictures.name: pd_bouguereau_song_of_the_angels

pictures.scene: Ary Scheffer, Christus Consolator — the woman pressing her face into the hand of Christ and not letting go, my soul clings to You, Your right hand upholds me
pictures.name: pd_scheffer_christus_consolator

pictures.scene: Thomas Moran, The Chasm of the Colorado — the ground split open into a gorge dropping away under the storm, but those who seek my life to destroy it will go into the depths of the earth
pictures.name: pd_moran_the_chasm_of_the_colorado

pictures.scene: Pieter Bruegel the Elder, The Suicide of Saul — the king and his armor-bearer fallen on their own swords while the battle goes past, they will fall to the power of the sword, they will become a portion for foxes
pictures.name: pd_bruegel_the_suicide_of_saul

pictures.scene: Jan de Bray, King David Playing the Harp — the crowned king at his harp with his eyes turned up and the singers around him, but the king will rejoice in God, all who swear by Him will exult
pictures.name: pd_de_bray_king_david_playing_the_harp

pictures.scene: Rembrandt, Haman Recognizes His Fate — the man in his red robe standing with his hand on his breast and nothing left to say, for the mouths of liars will be shut
pictures.name: pd_rembrandt_haman_recognizes_his_fate

lines.text: A Psalm of David, when he was in the Wilderness of Judah.
O God, You are my God.
Earnestly I seek You;
my soul thirsts for You.
My body yearns for You
in a dry and weary land without water.
So I have seen You in the sanctuary
and beheld Your power and glory.
Because Your loving devotion is better than life,
my lips will glorify You.
So I will bless You as long as I live;
in Your name I will lift my hands.
My soul is satisfied as with the richest of foods;
with joyful lips my mouth will praise You.
When I remember You on my bed,
I think of You through the watches of the night.
For You are my help;
I will sing for joy in the shadow of Your wings.
My soul clings to You;
Your right hand upholds me.
But those who seek my life to destroy it
will go into the depths of the earth.
They will fall to the power of the sword;
they will become a portion for foxes.
But the king will rejoice in God;
all who swear by Him will exult,
for the mouths of liars will be shut.
